tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi thugs rje la bskul ba'i yi ge bzhugs/ na mo buddha dhwa dza ye/ khyod rgyal ba'i 'phrin las drag po'i sku/ /dpal mahā kā la gur mgon zhes/ /yongs 'dzin ma'i phyogs kun khyab pa de'i/ /sku dngos dang mtshungs pa'i bse mgon che/ /rig sngags 'chang bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /dus ngan pa ding sang skabs 'di na/ /spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams re dma'/ /sgos sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'jig la thug /dus 'di la blo ldan kho bo sogs/ /bstan gsal bar 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams/ /thabs ji ltar byas kyang ngal ba 'di/ /bstan rin chen 'phel ba'i bar chad lags/ /rgyu des na mkhyen brtse nus ldan pa'i/ /khyed ye shes mgon po'i thugs rje yis/ /chos mthun pa'i don gyi log pa'i phyogs/ /'di thams cad myur du zhi bar mdzod/ /bstan bsam pa'i skye bo gser bas dkon/ /de dus rnams rtag tu ngal ba 'di/ /khyed bstan srung thugs kyis phod lags sam/ /rje gong ma'i dam tshig dran par mdzod/ /mi bdag gi bsam pa'i don 'di dag /sna gcig nyid ma lus mthar phyin te/ /spyi bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /dpe dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas par mdzod/ /blo gtad do gnyer ro srung ma'i tshogs/ /thugs ma g.yel ma g.yel mahā kā la/ /dus deng sang skabs kyi skye bo rnams/ /phal che ba bstan pa 'phel 'dod med/ /rgyu des na bdag gi mthun grogs nyung / /'di bsam gyin ye shes mgon po dran/ /thugs ma brjed brtse ba'i klong nas gzigs/ /dus 'du 'bral med par bskyang du gsol/ khyed bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes shing / /bdag bstan pa 'dzin par 'dod pa'i phyir/ /chos phan tshun rten 'brel phun sum tshogs/ /rgyu des na nam yang 'bral med zungs/ /bdag rnal 'byor nanda 'khor dang bcas/ /dus rtag tu nad med tshe ring zhing / /chos lugs gnyis bya ba mthar phyin te/ /spyi bye brag bstan pa rin po che/

/rab 'phel zhing yun du gnas par mdzod/ /de ltar 'phrin las bcol ba 'dis ka lyā na wardhantu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi thugs rje la bskul ba'i yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
